units.source_text: 夜色渐深之时，京中来了四五个殿上人。

en.t: As the night grew deeper, four or five courtiers arrived from the capital.

units.source_text: 这些人皆在御前侍候，宫中举行管弦之会时，

en.t: They were all attendants at court, and when a concert of wind and string music was held in the palace,

units.source_text: 皇上曾言：“六天斋戒，今已圆满，源氏内大臣必来参与奏乐，何以不见他到？”

en.t: the emperor had said, "The six days of purification are now complete. The Genji minister of the center is sure to come and join the music, so why has he not appeared?"

units.source_text: 有人启奏：大臣正游嵯峨桂院。

en.t: Someone reported to him that the minister was presently visiting the Katsura villa at Saga.
The emperor therefore sent a messenger to inquire after him.

units.source_text: 同来的钦差是藏人弁，带来冷泉帝的信中有云：

en.t: The imperial envoy who came with them was Kurodo no Ben, and the letter he brought from Emperor Reizei said:
